error.session_expired: Your session has expired, please sign in again.

error.report_font_missing: This report needs a Unicode font (report_font_path).
error.last_administrator: The last active administrator cannot be deactivated or lose the role.
punch.queued: Saved offline – it will be sent automatically
month.title: Month
admin.profile.pauseRulesHint: Rules for this employee only: they replace the company rule with the same “from minutes”. Without own rules the company table applies.
month.noteHint: Times are changed by the administration. A note here reaches the administration — for example “forgot to clock in or out”.
month.editHint: Only the administration changes times: add a punch, correct a time or remove a punch.
report.failed: The statement could not be created.
reports.title: Reports
absences.title: Absences
absences.typeHint: Code of the absence type, e.g. F for vacation
sync.title: Synchronisation
sync.permission: You are not allowed to resolve conflicts.
profile.title: Profile
profile.changed: Password changed, please sign in again.
admin.title: Administration
admin.forbidden: You are not allowed to open the administration.
admin.user.name: Name
admin.user.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case and digits.
admin.user.selfDeactivate: The own account cannot be deactivated — the running session would end at once and nobody could sign in any more. Please ask another administrator to do it.
admin.user.selfRoles: Careful: without the “Administrator” role you lose every administration right at once.
admin.user.lastAdminRoles: This is the last active administrator: the role cannot be taken away from it.
admin.backup.uploadHint: Pick a downloaded backup (.sqlite) - it is checked and applied on the next start.
admin.backup.deleteConfirm: The backup {{name}} is deleted. This cannot be undone.
admin.backup.retention: Backups older than {{days}} days are removed, the newest one is always kept.
terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.noPin: No PIN is needed on this terminal.
terminal.disabled: The terminal is switched off in the adapter settings.
admin.terminal.name: Name
admin.terminal.tokenOnce: Copy the device token now — it is stored as a hash and shown only once:
admin.terminal.url: Open this address on the kiosk device:
admin.terminal.usersHint: Leave everything off to show all employees on this terminal.
admin.terminal.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{{name}}”? Its device token stops working immediately.
admin.settings.fontPath: Unicode font file for PDF statements (.ttf/.otf)
admin.profile.pausePaidHint: That many minutes of the break count as working time (0 = the break is not paid).
admin.settings.pauseModeHint: How the break of a day is determined.
admin.settings.pauseRulesHint: Applies to days without a punched break: from the given block length (first to last punch of a block) the minutes are deducted.
admin.settings.fontPathHint: Needed for Russian, Ukrainian and Chinese; empty = built-in fonts, which only cover Latin-1.
admin.settings.advanced: All instance settings (technical names, 1/0 for switches)
admin.holiday.name: Name
admin.holiday.empty: No holiday recorded for this year.
admin.tag.label: Label
admin.tag.linkOnce: Write this link onto the tag or open it on the phone:
admin.tag.editHint: A different employee or a new validity issues a new link — the link handed out before stops working immediately.
admin.tag.oldLinkDead: The link handed out before no longer works.
admin.tag.qrAlt: QR code of the badge link
scan.title: Badge
scan.failed: The badge could not be used: {{reason}}
presence.title: Presence
presence.tapPin: Enter the PIN to clock in or out
presence.disabled: The kiosk terminal is switched off in the instance settings.
admin.user.photoHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF up to 256 KB. Without a picture the placeholder is shown.
corrections.reasonHint: Kept in the audit trail of the adapter
corrections.addHint: Leave “clock out” empty when only one punch is missing
admin.settings.brandingHint: Logo, background picture and background colour of this installation. The sign in screen and the kiosk screens show them as well.
admin.brand.imageTooLarge: Even scaled down the picture is still too big.
admin.brand.imageType: Only PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF are possible.
admin.brand.imageUnreadable: The picture could not be read.
admin.settings.brandColorHint: Hex value like #1a2b3c, empty for the default
admin.backup.restoreConfirm: The backup {{name}} is applied when the adapter starts next time; the current database is kept next to it as a file. Restart the instance afterwards.
admin.backup.pendingHint: {{name}} is applied when the adapter starts next time ({{users}} employees, {{entries}} punches) - restart the instance.
error.backup_invalid: That file is not a backup of this adapter.
admin.settings.brandColorDefaultHint: Resets the background colour and the background picture
admin.triggersHint: A state of another adapter punches or sets the presence — a fingerprint reader, a button or a door contact. It fires only when the value changes. As the value you can write `toggle`: then every change fires (for example on and off again).
admin.trigger.label: Label
admin.trigger.conditionHint: Value, or `toggle` to fire on every change
admin.settings.automationsHint: What the adapter does on its own: clock out at the configured local time, report a missing punch or remind after working too long without a break. A rule runs at most once per employee and day.
admin.user.workedTime: Working time on the presence card
admin.user.workedTimeHint: Shows the time worked today on the presence card (for example 1:23). Without a punch it reads 0:00; without this permission the card keeps present/absent and the name only.
admin.absenceTypes.title: Absence types
admin.absenceTypes.hint: Code, name and effect of the absences. “Visible for everybody” means the employees may pick the type in the app and request it — switched off it is there for the administration only (sickness, accident, military service).
admin.absenceTypes.name: Name
admin.absenceTypes.note: Existing absences keep their type — a changed name shows up everywhere right away.
admin.absences.title: Absences
admin.absences.pendingEmpty: No open request — everything is decided.
admin.absenceTypes.removeConfirm: Really remove “{{name}}”? Absences that still use this type have to be deleted or changed first.
absences.calendarHint: Subscribe to your absences in Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar. The link is a secret — whoever has it sees your absences.
admin.absences.yearHint: Every type shows up in the calendar with its own colour; requested days are faded. Public holidays are bold.
